changelog._extraSurfacesNote: This repo has the most changelog surfaces in the suite — three. Before 2026-07-31 the gate checked only CHANGELOG.md, so a release could pass green with the other two stale. v0.27.16 and v0.27.17 exist because exactly that drift accumulated to 17 missing versions.

extraSurfaces.note: Served copy. Keep byte-identical — copy the root file, do not hand-edit both.
In-app changelog rendered by ChangelogTab. Items are JSX, not strings, so a new entry must be authored as <>...</> fragments — see the existing entries. Do NOT copy markdown in verbatim.

_claudeMdNote: CLAUDE.md is gitignored, so the release checklist's consistency grep could never see version drift inside it — and this file sat at 0.21.1 / 'May 5, 2026' while the repo was at 0.27.13, THIRTEEN releases stale. Both `**Current Version:**` lines are checked. The `**Last Updated:**` line carries a date, not a version, so it cannot be machine-checked against package.json — update it by hand. Historical prose naming an old release is correct as written and is deliberately not matched. Skipped in CI, where the file is never checked out.
